title: Basket Totals
prompt: Create a class Basket that starts empty, add(item, price) appends items, and total() returns the sum of prices. add returns the new item count.

tests.name: empty basket totals zero
tests.hint: Initialize prices to an empty list in __init__.

tests.name: add and total
tests.code:
b = Basket()
assert b.add('tea', 3) == 1
assert b.add('cup', 4) == 2
assert b.total() == 7
tests.hint: add returns len of items after appending.
